source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.7, printed page 24.

blocks.text: Agar banne wala naya complex pehle wale se zyada stable ho to ligands ki substitution (ek ligand ki jagah doosra aana) hoti hai, aur naye complex ki properties, jaise rang, structure aur reactivity, badal jati hain. Copper(II) aur cobalt(II) ions ke complexes se ligand substitution reactions dikhaye ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: Ligand exchange
blocks.text: Ligand exchange (substitution) reaction mein complex ke ek ya zyada ligands doosre ligands se badal jate hain.

blocks.explanation: Jab naye ligands se banne wala complex asal complex se zyada stable ho.

items: Naya complex zyada stable ho to ligands badalte hain; rang, structure aur reactivity badal sakti hai.
